summary: Three medium-severity failures — erasure of the firetruck blush (comic voice marker), the 'stimulus for mating' explicit exchange (tonal contrast keystone), and the narrator's haze-of-lust interior monologue (consent/compulsion interpretive centre) — collectively constitute regeneration-level voice flattening.
